The bill would stop health practitioners from giving minors treatments meant to change their sex.
The Minister for Health and Aged Care would have to cancel a practitioner's licence if they break the ban.
A minor who began a course of puberty-blocking drugs within 14 days of the bill starting could continue if they had 12 or more counselling sessions over at least six months beforehand.
Prohibits health practitioners from providing gender transition treatments to minors.
Requires the Minister for Health and Aged Care to cancel the licence of a practitioner who contravenes the prohibition.
Creates exceptions for precocious puberty, genetic disorders, and ongoing treatment begun soon after the bill commences.
Health practitioners and minors under 18 years of age.
